# Amplifai

> Amplifai is a boutique AI studio that builds websites and ad creatives for
> small and medium-sized businesses internationally, including salons, medical
> spas, contractors, furniture and retail showrooms, and e-commerce brands.
> Projects are custom-quoted; there are no fixed public price packages.

## Services
- Website design and development (AI-accelerated, human-refined)
- Ad creative production (educational, UGC-style, and platform-native video
  ads for Meta, TikTok, and other platforms)
- Combined website + ad creative bundles for consistent brand launches

## Key Pages
- /work — Portfolio of website and ad creative projects, filterable by type and industry
- /services — Service descriptions and FAQ
- /about — Studio background, process, and founder information
- /contact — Project inquiry form; replies within 24 hours

## Contact
Inquiries: via the form at /contact
